name: Wordly
desc:
🧠 Can you guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries? Inspired by WORDLE!

HOW TO PLAY
- Guess the hidden 5-letter word in 6 attempts
- GREEN = right letter, right spot
- YELLOW = right letter, wrong spot
- GREY = letter not in the word

✨ FEATURES
- Daily streaks - keep yours alive!
- Leaderboards and stats
- Rank up from Rookie to Legend
- Unlock new Themes
- Hints and undo when you're stuck
- Invite friends, Join group,  and Favorite for FREE hints

📝 LATEST UPDATE
Rank Update - climb the ranks and prove you're a word master!

👍 Like and favorite if you enjoy the game, it helps us a lot!

🔨 Made by iTzAymxn

Tags: wordle, word game, guess the word, puzzle, 5 letter words
